correctionNote: V2 corrects only five descriptive 95%-availability reference N values in sampleSizeDesign. Selected sample sizes, power values, strata, seeds, endpoints, decision rules, multiplicity rules, and interpretation boundaries are unchanged. No E-019 formal data have been generated.
purpose: Test whether the search-profile dependence confirmed by E-018 generalizes across preregistered changes in search depth and evaluator while keeping each phase2-versus-legacy comparison paired on seed and random-opening boundary.
hypothesis: Capture-branch-expansion manifestation remains more frequent under phase2 than legacy in all three preregistered perturbation strata: bao/depth1, bao/depth3, and bao-v2/depth2.
interpretationBoundary: E-019 tests only the three preregistered strata. It does not alter E-018, does not imply all-depth or all-evaluator generality, and does not generalize to future search implementations.

corpus.nestedSeedDesign: The three strata intentionally use nested prefixes of one new master seed block. Pairing and primary inference are within stratum only; cross-stratum shared seeds are not treated as independent replication units.

designSources: E-011 formal condition and trajectory-ply results
independence.designUseOnly: Prior results are used only to motivate H17, preserve the E-018 primary endpoint, identify sparse-event risk, and select E-019 sample sizes before E-019 data generation.

primaryUnit.name: paired shared-seed game within stratum
primaryUnit.pairingRequirement: Within each stratum, phase2 and legacy must use the same seed and identical random-opening boundary state for every paired game.
primaryUnit.binaryEndpointPerCondition: 1 if the game contains at least one category-A candidate in the primary population classified as capture-branch-expansion; otherwise 0.

primaryEndpoint.name: stratum-specific paired search-profile difference in capture-branch-expansion manifestation
primaryEndpoint.comparison: phase2 versus legacy on the paired game-level binary endpoint, separately within D1, D3, and V2
primaryEndpoint.test: two-sided exact McNemar test on discordant pairs
primaryEndpoint.directionRequirement: phase2-only discordant pairs must exceed legacy-only discordant pairs
reportedEffectMeasures: discordant-pair odds ratio n10/n01 with infinity reported when n01=0

sampleSizeDesign.method: Sparse-event stress design using a binomial model for discordant-pair availability and unconditional exact-McNemar power under a prespecified conservative directional effect.

stressAssumption.note: The assumed discordant odds ratio 4.0 is weaker than E-018's observed ratio 7.0 and is used for planning only.

sampleSizeDesign.caveat: These are preregistration planning calculations, not evidence for H17. No E-019 observed data may be used to revise the selected sample sizes or success rules after formal generation begins.

conditionDecisionRule.pass: Formal integrity and within-stratum pairing pass, at least 20 discordant paired games are available, the two-sided exact McNemar p-value is <=0.05, and phase2-only discordant pairs exceed legacy-only discordant pairs.
conditionDecisionRule.fail: Formal integrity and within-stratum pairing pass and at least 20 discordant paired games are available, but the preregistered McNemar significance or direction criterion fails.
conditionDecisionRule.insufficient: Formal integrity and within-stratum pairing pass, but fewer than 20 discordant paired games are available.
conditionDecisionRule.inconclusive: Corpus generation, schema/hash/source validation, paired-opening validation, seed pairing, candidate-event construction, or required output construction fails for the stratum.

globalDecisionRule.framework: intersection-union test (IUT) for the conjunction that all three preregistered strata preserve the phase2-over-legacy effect
globalDecisionRule.multiplicity: No Bonferroni reduction is applied to the component alpha for the global conjunction decision; every component hypothesis must independently pass at alpha 0.05.
globalDecisionRule.confirmed: D1, D3, and V2 all have condition decision pass.
globalDecisionRule.notConfirmed: At least one stratum has condition decision fail after valid formal integrity.
globalDecisionRule.inconclusive: No stratum fails, but at least one stratum is insufficient or technically inconclusive.

individualStandaloneInference.purpose: Control family-wise error if reporting any stratum as a standalone generalized confirmation rather than merely as a component of the IUT global claim.
individualStandaloneInference.method: Holm-Bonferroni over the three exact McNemar p-values
individualStandaloneInference.report: Store raw and Holm-adjusted p-values. A condition-level pass used by the IUT does not by itself imply a Holm-confirmed standalone claim.

perCondition: trajectory-ply-deduplicated candidate versus control expansion rates and risk ratio
structuralSecondaryEndpoint.withinStratumDirectComparison: Compare capture-branch-expansion rates among unique candidate trajectory-ply units between phase2 and legacy; report Fisher exact two-sided p-value, risk ratio, and risk difference.
structuralSecondaryEndpoint.decisionBoundary: Structural secondary results never replace, override, rescue, or reverse the paired game-level McNemar condition decisions or the global IUT decision.

secondaryEndpoints: Raw candidate and control expansion counts and rates by condition
Candidate and expansion archetype counts by condition
Common-prefix cross-stratum descriptive comparisons on seeds shared by D1, D3, and V2

executionPolicy.approvalRequirement: A separate explicit user instruction specific to E-019 is required before generating any E-019 formal corpus. E-011, E-017, and E-018 approvals do not carry over.

changePolicy: Any post-preregistration change to strata, sample sizes, seed ranges, conditions, candidate/regime thresholds, primary population, primary unit, exact McNemar test, alpha, direction rule, minimum discordant pairs, IUT global contract, Holm standalone inference, or primary/secondary boundary requires a new preregistration version. E-019 results may not be used to relax this file after formal data generation starts.
